key_reasoning.reason: New BudgetService.provision_default_budgets orchestration (target resolution, bounded gather, per-category provisioning) plus protocol/registry/feature-gate/enterprise adapter changes, wired into five user-lifecycle entry points (user management create, registration, post-verification, IdP first login, dev header) and local auth and projects routers.

No exact precedent: fail-open provisioning under an asyncio deadline on login and registration hot paths, concurrent provider calls with a shared slot, idempotency against the existing lazy-assignment mirror, and enforcement-gate behaviour. Defensive edge-case coverage (timeout, unavailable provider, unknown category) is new test surface.
19 files changed (10 source, 9 test), 1036 insertions, 110 deletions across budget service, user services, routers and enterprise adapter; diffstat maps to XXL, although about half are test files.
